descriptions.w3d_component_list_get_80060a2c: Returns the global registry list that tracks every instance of this component type.
descriptions.w3d_component_unlink_80060a38: Removes a component from its type registry list and decrements the registry count.
descriptions.w3d_component_create_80060a7c: Allocates and constructs a component, links it into its type registry and increments the count.
descriptions.w3d_component_release_80060adc: Drops one reference; when none remain, unlinks the component and destroys it.
descriptions.w3d_component_retain_80060b38: Adds one reference and returns the previous reference count.
descriptions.w3d_component_construct_80060b50: Runs the base constructor, installs this type's vtable and clears its own fields.
descriptions.w3d_component_destroy_80060ba0: Reinstalls this type's vtable, releases the interfaces it holds, then runs the base destructor.
descriptions.w3d_component_handle_message_80060c38: On message 64 runs the base handler then a follow-up step; on 66 runs another step first; otherwise defers to the base.
descriptions.w3d_component_stop_80060fe0: Empty handler step that does nothing.
